status: APPROVED by the user on 2026-11-04, before any Stage 3 data existed. Do not change after looking at results; if a change is needed, record it as a new dated version.
why: Fixes how the main run is analysed so that nothing is chosen after seeing results (plan section 10.3).

notes.primary_alpha: Five primary contrasts per adapter, each judged at 99% (Bonferroni: 0.05 / 5).
notes.min_effect: A primary contrast counts as SUPPORTED only if its interval excludes 0 AND the effect is at least this large. In a simulation with no true effects (4000 resamples) the intervals gave 1.8% false alarms, all smaller than 3.7 points; the size floor guards against such cases.
notes.family: Which wording family is used. The other family stays untouched for replicating the key findings.
notes.interactions: Reported with 95% intervals and labelled exploratory.
